article.title: Grantor’s duty not to render property unsafe.
article.content:
58Grantor’s duty not to render property unsafe.

Section 58  ·  Chapter VI  ·  page 19 of the Act
The grantor of a license is bound not to do anything likely to render the property affected by the license dangerous to the person or property of the licensee.
